breathEffect.reason: The action supplies its own body motion; no extra breathing deformation during locomotion, laughter, flight or waking.

name: Common/Walk/Lu_Walk_Right
description: Relaxed right walk in place using eight contact, down, passing and up key drawings.
notes: Eight complete built-in imagegen drawings. Whole-figure extraction and uniform per-drawing registration; no cutout rig, body warping, frame blending or optical flow. Scale v6: one fixed whole-character transform per clip, matched to the standing-idle median opaque head silhouette area. It includes eyes/mouth, so blinking does not change the scale estimate. No frame-specific scaling, head/body cuts, or pose-height normalization. Grounded contacts remain y592; flight clearance is transformed about the shared root. Pose projection, breathing and original drawing proportions remain intact.
